==Description==
'''Torchlight''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Solar Eclipse Event#Solar Eclipse Season Pass|Solar Eclipse Season Pass]]. It was created by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 2 of the Event Season Pass, which cost {{SolarShard|225 Solar Shards}} or {{Robux|75}} at that rank. The total cost was {{SolarShard|375 Solar Shards}} or {{Robux|125}}.
